notes: Lower-carb, blood-sugar-friendly plan: half the plate vegetables, a quarter protein, a quarter (or less) wholegrain or low-GI carbs. No white rice, white bread, sugary cereal or juice; fruit is eaten whole. Laurence does not have rice: each rice meal shows her swap. Snacks: the meals give Raja about 1,400 kcal, so add about 300 kcal of snacks a day (for example 25g unsalted nuts mid-afternoon plus 150g Greek-style yogurt, or carrot sticks with hummus). Laurence adds about 150 to 200 kcal (one of those). No biscuits, sweets or juice. Optional for Raja: eat between 12:00 and 18:00. Skip breakfast, add the eggs or yogurt to lunch at noon, a small snack around 15:00, shared dinner around 17:30. Same cooking and shop for both. This is general healthy-eating guidance, not medical advice; keep up your usual GP check-ups.

breakfast.name: Berry porridge with pumpkin seeds
steps: Simmer the oats. Cook 70g oats in 350ml fortified semi-skimmed milk for about 5 minutes, stirring.
Finish the bowls. Share into two bowls, stir a spoon of Greek-style yogurt into each, then top with the berries and pumpkin seeds. No sugar, honey or syrup; a pinch of cinnamon is fine.

portions.laurence: 30g oats, 150ml milk, 80g yogurt, 60g berries, 10g seeds

lunch.name: Mild chicken palak with brown rice

ingredients.item: Halal chicken breast or skinless thigh

steps: Cook Raja's rice. Rinse 80g brown or wholegrain basmati rice and boil according to the pack (about 25 minutes). Laurence has her swap instead (see below). Cook enough for today and Monday.
Laurence's potatoes. Halve 100g new potatoes, skins on, and boil 15 minutes until tender.

Cook the chicken. Gently fry 1 chopped onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and a little grated ginger in 1 tsp oil with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp turmeric. Add 600g diced halal chicken and cook until the outside is no longer pink. No chilli.
Simmer. Add 1 tin chopped tomatoes and 400g frozen spinach. Simmer 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Finish with a pinch of garam masala and lemon.
Makes four portions; chill half for Monday lunch. Fill half of each plate with the palak and a cucumber salad. Keep tea and coffee for an hour after this meal.
